summary: GMEX Robotics Corp, a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer listed in the US, filed a 6-K reporting the October 14, 2026 consummation of its Initial Acquisition of 30% of Alpha Meta AI Pte. Ltd., a Singapore issuer whose MediaMeta business spans digital content, AI applications and generative engine optimization. The SPA set a reference equity valuation of US$8.4 million, implying a US$2.52 million purchase price. A First Amendment shifted consideration from 60% cash/40% Class A shares to 15% cash/85% Class C preferred, convertible into common at Closing VWAP with a 24-month lockup. What to watch: dilution and conversion overhang.
